text: {name1} has chronically freezing hands and intentionally slips them under {name2}'s sweater just to hear them yelp. {name2} groans every time, but never actually pulls away.
Whenever {name1} falls asleep on the couch, {name2} will tiptoe around the entire house whispering to inanimate objects so they don't wake them up.
{name2} bought an oversized hoodie specifically so {name1} could steal it. When {name1} wore it the first time, {name2} pretended to be upset while secretly taking ten pictures.
{name1} can't fall asleep unless their pinky finger is touching {name2}'s hand, even when it's too hot for full cuddling.
{name2} keeps a secret notes app full of everything {name1} offhandedly mentions liking throughout the year, just to surprise them on their birthday.
{name1} kisses the top of {name2}'s head every single time they walk past them while {name2} is focused on work or reading.
When they dance in private, {name2} always pulls {name1} onto their feet so they can slow dance in socks across the kitchen floor.
{name1} is terrible at remembering their own umbrella, but will literally sprint through a rainstorm just to deliver one to {name2}.
{name2} knows {name1}'s exact coffee/tea order by heart, down to the temperature and number of sugar packets, and orders it before {name1} even steps up to the counter.
{name1} talks in their sleep, and {name2} holds quiet 2:00 AM conversations with them just to see what weird things {name1} will reply.
{name1} keeps waiting for the other shoe to drop, terrified that one day {name2} will wake up and realize they deserve someone better.
During their worst argument, {name2} almost walked out the front door, but paused on the threshold when {name1}'s voice cracked asking: 'Please don't let me be right about everyone leaving.'
{name1} still flinches at raised voices or sudden movements, and {name2} takes a quiet, deliberate breath every time, waiting patiently until {name1} remembers they are safe.
{name2} had a nightmare where {name1} forgot who they were. {name2} woke up gasping, only to find {name1} awake, immediately pulling them in and repeating their own name over and over.
{name1} refuses to let {name2} see them cry, hiding in the bathroom with the faucet running until {name2} knocks softly and says, 'I'm sitting on the other side of this door until you're ready.'
They both know their time together has an expiration date, but neither mentions it, choosing instead to love each other twice as hard every single day.
{name2} finds an old unsent letter {name1} wrote during their darkest chapter, realizing just how close they came to losing {name1} before they ever truly found each other.
{name1} would burn down the entire world to protect {name2}, but {name2}'s greatest fear is becoming the reason {name1} loses their own humanity.
{name1} and {name2} are supposed to be mortal rivals, yet they have an unspoken truce: no one else is permitted to harm or defeat the other.
Trapped in an elevator together, {name1} notices {name2} hyperventilating and quietly drops all hostility, offering their hand: 'Truce. Just breathe with me, idiot.'
{name2} spends twenty minutes insulting {name1}'s life choices while gently bandaging {name1}'s bleeding wound with expert precision.
'If you die, I will drag your soul back from hell just to kill you myself,' {name1} snaps, right before throwing themselves in front of {name2} to take a hit.
{name2} accidentally calls {name1} when severely injured because out of everyone in the world, {name1} is the only one who wouldn't lecture them before helping.
Their first kiss happens during a heated argument—mid-sentence, inches apart, where anger abruptly snaps into desperate, breathless mutual desire.
{name1} memorized all of {name2}'s fighting habits and quirks under the excuse of 'studying my adversary,' only to realize they just memorized everything about {name2}.
Everyone in their friend group had a betting pool on when {name1} and {name2} would finally confess. The pot was won by someone who bet on 'after an accidental 3:00 AM forehead touch.'
{name1} realizes their feelings first when watching someone else flirt with {name2} and feeling an unexpected, sharp ache in their chest.
They've shared a bed as platonic best friends for years, until one night {name2} rolls over, looks at {name1} in the moonlight, and forgets how to breathe.
'We've been dating in everything but name for three years, {name2},' {name1} says with an exasperated laugh. 'Did you really think I look at anyone else like this?'
{name2} always leans their head on {name1}'s shoulder during movies. One evening, {name1} nervously rests their cheek against {name2}'s hair, and {name2} leans in closer instead of pulling away.
Grocery shopping is a chaotic sport: {name1} sneakily drops expensive snacks into the cart when {name2} isn't looking, while {name2} inspects every vegetable like an expert detective.
Sunday mornings have a strict silent ritual: {name2} makes pancakes while {name1} sits on the kitchen counter wrapped in a duvet, half-asleep waiting for coffee.
{name1} is banned from assembling flat-pack IKEA furniture alone because they always lose three screws and end up sitting on the floor in pure existential dread until {name2} takes over.
They have an ongoing silent battle where {name2} keeps trying to adjust the room thermostat and {name1} keeps stealthily switching it back five minutes later.
{name1} always leaves sweet or completely nonsensical post-it notes on the bathroom mirror for {name2} to read before work.
Sharing a closet was supposed to be 50/50, but {name2}'s clothes have somehow migrated into 80% of the hangers, and {name1} doesn't even complain anymore.
{name1} once tried to be smooth and waltz {name2} into a dramatic dip, but tripped over a rug and they both crashed into a laundry basket laughing hysterically.
{name2} gets competitive over the most ridiculous things. Board game night with {name1} is treated with the strategic gravity of the Geneva Convention.
{name1} claims they don't like pets, but within 48 hours of {name2} bringing home a kitten, {name1} was spotted giving the cat a customized baby voice and tucked into their jacket.
When {name1} is drunk, they become intensely loyal and repeatedly tell complete strangers, 'Don't talk to me, I have a spouse and their name is {name2} and they are way out of your league.'
{name2} communicates with {name1} entirely across crowded rooms using a sophisticated repertoire of eyebrow raises, eye rolls, and silent mouthings of 'help me.'
[Coffee Shop AU] {name1} purposely orders complicated drinks just so barista {name2} has to take longer talking to them, completely oblivious to the fact that {name2} draws tiny hearts on the cup.
[Soulmates AU] Every bruise or scratch {name1} gets shows up on {name2}'s skin. One day, {name2} writes a message on their forearm in ballpoint pen: 'Will you please stop walking into doorframes?'
[Royalty AU] {name1} is the rebellious monarch and {name2} is their sworn bodyguard. During official galas, {name1} constantly breaks protocol just to pull {name2} onto the dance floor.
[College AU] {name2} is the exhausted library tutor and {name1} is the student who clearly doesn't need help with calculus, but keeps showing up every Tuesday at 6:00 PM anyway.
[Hanahaki Disease AU] {name1} coughs up flower petals of {name2}'s favorite blossom, desperately hiding the truth until {name2} catches them and whispers: 'You idiot... it's you too.'
{name1} backs {name2} against the kitchen counter, trapping them with both arms. With a low, teasing whisper: 'You've been distracted all day. Care to tell me why?'
{name2} has a habit of gently tugging on {name1}'s tie or collar when pulling them in for a kiss, completely destroying {name1}'s composure in seconds.
In a crowded formal party, {name1}'s hand never leaves {name2}'s lower back, subtle fingers tracing warm circles under the fabric of their clothes.
{name2} playfully whispers something scandalous into {name1}'s ear right before an important meeting, smirking as {name1} blushes bright red and clears their throat repeatedly.
When watching a scary movie, {name1} insists they aren't scared at all, yet their fingers remain death-gripped into {name2}'s bicep the entire time.
{name2} loves resting their chin on {name1}'s shoulder from behind while {name1} is cooking, inhaling the scent of their shampoo.
{name1} and {name2} have an emergency code word that means: 'Create a theatrical distraction so we can escape this awkward social interaction immediately.'
Standing back-to-back surrounded by enemies, {name1} grins: 'Try not to fall in love with my sword work.' {name2} scoffs: 'Try not to trip on your own ego.'
{name2} stays awake listening to {name1}'s steady breathing, counting the beats of their heart like an anchor in a stormy sea.
{name1} always steals {name2}'s side of the bed when {name2} gets up to get water, because 'it's already pre-warmed.'
{name1} accidentally whispers 'I love you' while handing {name2} a cup of coffee. The entire room goes dead silent as {name1} freezes and {name2}'s eyes go wide.
[Fake Dating AU] {name1} and {name2} agree to fake date for a family wedding, only to realize by the reception toast that neither of them is pretending anymore.
{name2} pins {name1}'s hands above their head against the headboard, breath hot against their neck: 'Say my name and tell me what you want.'
{name2} has a special soft smile that {name1} only ever sees when they think nobody is watching.
